name: infectiology
description: Datenpaket für Infektiologen: Post-infektiöse Verlaufsdaten, PEM-Muster, Labor (Entzündung, Erreger-Serologie), Symptomzeitachse, autonome Funktion
description_en: Data package for infectious disease specialists: post-infectious course, PEM pattern, labs (inflammation, serology), symptom timeline, autonomic function

queries.pem_correlation: SELECT date, training_load, steps, active_energy, belastungs_score, hrv_heute, rhr_heute, hrv_morgen, rhr_morgen, hrv_delta_pct, rhr_delta, pem_signal, pem_staerke, had_sport, sport_prior_3d FROM pem_correlation WHERE date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.infection_labs: SELECT date, parameter, wert AS value, einheit AS unit, ref_min AS range_min, ref_max AS range_max, status, labor AS lab FROM lab_all WHERE person = :person AND parameter IN ('CRP','CRP-hs','Blutsenkung 1. Std','BSG 1h','Leukozyten','Lymphozyten','Neutrophile','Monozyten','Thrombozyten','Ferritin','LDH','Interleukin 6','D-Dimer','Fibrinogen n. Clauss','vWF Antigen','vWF RCo Aktivität','vWF RCo:vWF Ag Ratio','PCT','EBV VCA-IgG','EBV VCA-IgM','EBV EBNA-1-IgG','CMV IgG','CMV IgM','Parvovirus-IgG','Parvovirus-IgM','Borrelien IgG','Borrelien IgM','SARS-CoV-2 Ak (IgG)','COVID-IgM','COVID-Antigen','BSG','BSG_1h','IL-6','Fibrinogen','vWF','EBV-VCA-IgG','EBV-VCA-IgM','EBV-EBNA-IgG','CMV-IgG','CMV-IgM','Borrelien-IgG','Borrelien-IgM','COVID-IgG') AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date, parameter
queries.postinfectious_symptoms: SELECT date, symptom, value_num, value_text, category FROM symptoms WHERE person = :person AND (symptom LIKE '%Fatigue%' OR symptom LIKE '%Erschöpfung%' OR symptom LIKE '%PEM%' OR symptom LIKE '%Crash%' OR symptom LIKE '%Fieber%' OR symptom LIKE '%fever%' OR symptom LIKE '%Lymphknoten%' OR symptom LIKE '%lymph%' OR symptom LIKE '%Halsschmerz%' OR symptom LIKE '%sore_throat%' OR symptom LIKE '%Kopfschmerz%' OR symptom LIKE '%headache%' OR symptom LIKE '%Muskelschmerz%' OR symptom LIKE '%myalgia%' OR symptom LIKE '%brain_fog%' OR symptom LIKE '%Kognition%' OR symptom LIKE '%Kurzatmigkeit%' OR symptom LIKE '%dyspnea%') AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.orthostatic_tests: SELECT date, hr_supine, hr_stand_peak, hr_stand, hr_delta, rmssd_supine, rmssd_stand, rmssd_delta, source_app FROM orthostatic_test WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.daily_overview: SELECT date, person, sleep_score, sleep_duration_min AS total_sleep_min, hrv_rmssd_ms, resting_hr_bpm AS hr_resting, spo2_avg_pct AS spo2_avg, NULL AS spo2_min, resp_rate_avg AS respiration_avg, steps, active_energy_kcal AS active_calories, ROUND(stress_high_s/60.0,1) AS stress_high_min FROM daily_context WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.clinical_findings: SELECT finding_date, period_end, category, finding_type, value, unit, threshold, status, severity, description FROM clinical_findings WHERE finding_date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY severity, finding_date
queries.medications: SELECT ts, date, drug_name, dose_value, dose_unit, route, notes FROM medications WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts

algorithm_note: PEM-Muster aus pem_correlation sind heuristische Näherungswerte (Consumer-Wearable-Daten), kein klinisch validierter Test. pem_signal und pem_staerke sind Schwellwert-basiert; Interpretation erfordert klinischen Kontext.
